headline.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
headline.summary: Waze is introducing new AI-powered features, including the integration of Google's AI assistant, Gemini, to enhance user personalization during trips. Among the updates, improvements to the conversation reporting feature from 2024 are also being implemented.

articles.title: ARCANA: A Reflective Multi-Agent Program Synthesis Framework for ARC-AGI-2 Reasoning
articles.summary: ARCANA is a new multi-agent framework designed for solving ARC AGI 2 tasks while adhering to strict time and hardware constraints. The framework utilizes a structured approach that includes perception, hypothesis generation, symbolic execution, and reflective refinement to enhance task performance.

articles.title: OpenProver: Agentic and Interactive Theorem Proving with Lean 4
articles.summary: OpenProver is an open-source system designed for LLM-driven automated theorem proving, utilizing Lean 4 for formal verification. It features a Planner-Worker-Verifier architecture that allows for efficient decomposition of mathematical tasks into parallel processes.

articles.title: Task-Specific Multimodal Question Answering Agents via Confidence Calibration and Incremental Reasoning for QANTA 2026
articles.summary: The article discusses a submission for the QANTA 2026 shared challenge, focusing on multimodal question answering systems that respond to pyramid-style questions using incrementally revealed text and images. The challenge involves two tasks, including Tossup questions that test the system's ability to determine the optimal moment to answer based on incomplete information.

articles.title: 4DR360: State Reasoning for Joint 3D Detection and Occupancy Prediction in 4D Radar-Camera Full-Scene Perception
articles.summary: The article presents a novel approach called 4DR360, which enhances joint 3D detection and occupancy prediction by integrating 4D radar and camera data for improved full-scene perception in autonomous driving. This method addresses the limitations of existing radar-camera fusion techniques by enabling better interaction between object detection and semantic layout understanding.

articles.title: PACE: A Personalized Adaptive Curriculum Engine for 9-1-1 Call-taker Training
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of PACE, a Personalized Adaptive Curriculum Engine designed to enhance 9-1-1 call-taker training by tailoring objectives to individual trainees' evolving competencies. This initiative aims to address the challenges posed by a nationwide labor shortage and the complexity of training requirements in emergency response.

articles.title: M4V: Multimodal Mamba for Efficient Text-to-Video Generation
articles.summary: The article discusses M4V, a new framework for efficient text-to-video generation that addresses the computational challenges associated with traditional Transformer models. By utilizing advancements in linear-time sequence modeling, M4V aims to enhance the practicality of creating dynamic video content from textual descriptions.

articles.title: H3Former: Hypergraph-based Semantic-Aware Aggregation via Hyperbolic Hierarchical Contrastive Loss for Fine-Grained Visual Classification
articles.summary: The article presents H3Former, a novel approach for Fine-Grained Visual Classification (FGVC) that utilizes hypergraph-based semantic-aware aggregation and hyperbolic hierarchical contrastive loss. This method aims to improve the identification of subtle inter-class differences and reduce category-agnostic redundancy in existing FGVC techniques.

articles.title: Empowering 9-1-1 Calltaking Training with Generative AI: Experiences and Lessons Learned
articles.summary: A recent study explores the use of generative AI to enhance training for 9-1-1 call-takers, addressing significant staffing shortages and the extensive time required for onboarding new hires. The findings highlight the potential for AI-driven solutions to improve training efficiency and effectiveness in emergency response centers.

articles.title: GAP-GDRNet: Geometry-aware monocular 6D pose estimation for spacecraft using synthetic geometric supervision
articles.summary: The article introduces GAP-GDRNet, a geometry-aware RGB framework designed for monocular 6D pose estimation of spacecraft, addressing challenges such as weak texture and occlusion. The method enhances the geometry-guided regression pipeline by incorporating global structural attention before dense geometric prediction.

articles.title: Lorde says Ray-Ban Meta AI glasses are ‘not sexy’
articles.summary: During her performance at the Real Cool Festival in Madrid, Lorde criticized AI glasses, implying they lack appeal, likely referencing the Ray-Ban Meta AI smartglasses. Her comments highlight ongoing discussions about the aesthetics and acceptance of wearable AI technology.

articles.title: CogniConsole: Externalizing Inference-Time Control as a Formal Abstraction for Reliable LLM Interactions
articles.summary: The article introduces CogniConsole, a new architectural framework that externalizes inference-time control to enhance the reliability of large language model (LLM) interactions. It argues that reliability is more influenced by the mechanisms of task framing and context selection than by model capability alone.
